description: Read a page path returned by search or list_entities. Returns the full English API record where available; localized and search-only records return explicitly marked previews. Null remains unknown. Arrays are paged at up to 48 rows; use a pagination field with its nextOffset to continue.

field.description: Optional JSON pointer within data, such as /uses, /ranks or /recipes/0/materials.

limit.description: Rows per result, at most the site collection size of 48.

offset.description: Use nextOffset from the previous result; start at 0.

path.description: Exact path or production URL returned by search, including its language prefix and selection fragment.

name: get_entity
